# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolchild  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a dark, sullen little face and black eyes. His eyes sparkle with curiosity and mockery when he is being mischievous.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023)_

## Personality

Anthony is a sullen, impertinent, and mischievous boy who holds a general contempt for female teachers. He behaves with a scornful swagger, frequently mocking authority while obeying just enough to avoid open confrontation. Despite his hostile attitude, he can be winced into tears when severely disciplined.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)_

## Traits

- sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye, an orphan, was taken in by his aunt, Mrs. George Pye, and began attending Avonlea school under Anne Shirley. From the beginning, he displayed a hostile attitude toward Anne, remarking that she was not any good just like all girl teachers. On one occasion, he poured water from his slate bottle down Aurelia Clay's neck and remained indifferent to Anne's gentle lecture on being a gentleman. Although he rarely openly disobeyed Anne, he obeyed with a scornful air that undermined her authority. Later, after putting a live mouse in Anne's desk drawer, he was whipped by Anne using a pointer, which reduced him to tears and caused Anne to regret losing any remaining chance of winning his affection.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P34](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0034)_
